content: Bee gbɛa ma malaika gbɛ̃ↄn síiↄ̃ↄ è zɛzɛ dṹnia gola síiↄ̃wa, an baade a gola ĩ́ana kũa, kɛ́ ĩ́ana su pɛ tↄↄlɛ ge ísia ge líewao yã́i.
Ɔ̃ ma malaika pãle è, à bↄ̀ gukpɛ oi, a Lua bɛ̃́ɛ seelakɛbↄ kũa. À lɛ́ gbãa zù malaika gbɛ̃ↄn síiↄ̃ pↄ́ wà ń gbá zɛ́ aa tↄↄlɛ ń ísiao ↄ̃̀ↄkpapiↄzi
à mɛ̀: Ásu tↄↄlɛ ge ísia ge líↄ ↄ̃̀ↄkpao e wà seelakɛ wá Lua zↄ̀blenaↄ mi'aɛwa.
Ɔ̃ wà gbɛ̃́ pↄ́ wà seelapi kɛ̀máↄ lɛ́ òmɛɛ, aa gbɛ̃ↄn ↄ̀aasↄsↄo lɛɛ basopla ń síiↄ̃oɛ (144.000). Aa bↄ̀ Isaili bui píi guu.

content.text: Wà seelakɛ̀ Yuda buiↄwa gbɛ̃ↄn ↄ̀aasↄsↄo lɛɛ kuɛpla (12.000)
ń Lubɛni buiↄ gbɛ̃ↄn ↄ̀aasↄsↄo lɛɛ kuɛpla
ń Gada buiↄ gbɛ̃ↄn ↄ̀aasↄsↄo lɛɛ kuɛpla
ń Asɛɛ buiↄ gbɛ̃ↄn ↄ̀aasↄsↄo lɛɛ kuɛpla
ń Nɛfatali buiↄ gbɛ̃ↄn ↄ̀aasↄsↄo lɛɛ kuɛpla
ń Manase buiↄ gbɛ̃ↄn ↄ̀aasↄsↄo lɛɛ kuɛpla
ń Simɛↄ buiↄ gbɛ̃ↄn ↄ̀aasↄsↄo lɛɛ kuɛpla
ń Levii buiↄ gbɛ̃ↄn ↄ̀aasↄsↄo lɛɛ kuɛpla
ń Isakaa buiↄ gbɛ̃ↄn ↄ̀aasↄsↄo lɛɛ kuɛpla
ń Zabulↄni buiↄ gbɛ̃ↄn ↄ̀aasↄsↄo lɛɛ kuɛpla
ń Yosɛfu buiↄ gbɛ̃ↄn ↄ̀aasↄsↄo lɛɛ kuɛpla
ń Bɛ̃yãmɛɛ buiↄ gbɛ̃ↄn ↄ̀aasↄsↄo lɛɛ kuɛpla.

content: Bee gbɛa ma gbɛ̃́ↄ è dasidasi, wa fↄ̃ ń naoo. Aa bↄ̀ bùsu píi guu, bui píi guu, gbɛ̃́pii guu, buiyã píi guu. Aa zɛzɛa kpalabaa ń São aɛ. Aa ulatao pua dadaa, kpakpa lá nanaa ń ↄzĩ.
Aalɛ wii gbãa lɛ́, aalɛ mɛ: Wá Lua pↄ́ zↄ̃lɛa báawa ń São mɛ́ ì ń suaba.
Malaikaↄ zɛzɛ aa lìa kpalabaazi ń gbɛ̃zↄ̃ↄↄ ń pↄ́ bɛ̃́ɛ mɛ̀n síiↄ̃ↄ ḿpii, ↄ̃ aa ń mi pɛ̀lɛpɛlɛ báapi aɛ, aa kùlɛ Luaɛ

content.text: Ãmi! Wá Lua mɛ́ tↄ́ vĩ ń gawio
ń ↄ̃nↄo ń sáabuo ń bɛɛɛo
ń ikoo ń gbãao gↄↄpii. Ãmi!

content: Ɔ̃ gbɛ̃zↄ̃ↄpiↄ do ma la à mɛ̀: Deↄn ulataopuadanapiↄ ũi? Aa bↄ̀ má ni?
Má òɛ̀: Baa, ḿmɛ ń dↄ̃. Ɔ̃ a òmɛɛ: Gbɛ̃́ pↄ́ aa bↄ̀ wɛ́tɛ̃a zↄ̃ↄ
guuↄnɛ. Aa ń ulataopiↄ pì Sã au guu à puakũ̀.
Bee yã́i aa ku Lua kpalabaa aɛ, aaìↄ zↄbleɛ̀ aà kpɛ́u fãanɛ ń gwãasĩnao, mɛ́ gbɛ̃́ pↄ́ zↄ̃lɛa báawapi ì ↄkuńla.
Nↄana ge imi a ń dɛ lↄo, ĩatɛ̃ a ń lɛ́o, mɛ́ gu a wãmáo,
asa Sã pↄ́ zɛa báapiwa guoguo a ń dã́,
i dↄaanɛ́ e nibↄna í wɛ̃nidei,
mɛ́ Lua a ń wɛ́'i gogonɛ́ píi.
